rules.title: Every order shows the category of its own SKU
rules.detail: 9 of 21 categories are wrong, e.g. O-5003 (P-410): 'Electronics' instead of 'Stationery'; O-5012 (P-469): 'Electronics' instead of 'Kitchen'; O-5015 (P-410): 'Electronics' instead of 'Stationery'

rules.title: Every order shows the unit price of its own SKU
rules.detail: 14 of 21 unit prices are wrong, e.g. O-5002 (P-575): 74.57 instead of 109.11; O-5003 (P-410): 310.22 instead of 152.06; O-5004 (P-575): 74.57 instead of 109.11
